name: Pn7160 I2C → On Emulated Tag Scan
description:
An automation to perform when the PN7160 is scanned by another tag reader (such as a smartphone). See [`on_emulated_tag_scan` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/pn7160/#pn7160-on_emulated_tag_scan).

If card/tag emulation is enabled, this automation will be triggered when another reader (such as a smartphone) scans the PN7160 and reads the NDEF message it responds with. No parameters are available to this action because data is only sent *from* the PN7160 *to* the scanning device.
